texts:
Forge Max is a $THREE holder perk. That is the half worth saying out loud.

You hold $25 in it. You do not spend it. The 200k-poly lane turns on while you hold.

three.ws/three

The ladder is the utility.

Bronze at $25: 5% off all $THREE compute and double the free generation quota.

Gold at $500: 20% off and five times the quota.

Same tokens the whole time. Holding, not burning.

Draft and standard generation stay free, forever, held tokens or not.

The hold is for the expensive lanes: 200k-poly with PBR, game-ready retopo for Unity and Unreal. That is what $THREE is for here.

issues.quote: That is the half worth saying out loud.
issues.problem: This sentence adds rhythm but no information, and 'the half' has no referent until post 2; a first-time reader learns that Forge Max is a holder perk but not yet that it gates 3D generation lanes.
issues.fix: Optional: replace with 'Hold, not spend: the expensive generation lanes turn on while the tokens stay in your wallet.' if you want the mechanism in the first line.

issues.problem: Borderline aphorism; it works here because the next two lines give the checkable tiers, but on its own it would read as copywriting.
issues.fix: Optional: 'The ladder is the utility: Bronze $25, Gold $500, same tokens held the whole time.' to fuse the claim with the numbers.

Voice is compliant (no hashtags, emoji, dashes, or hype) and both flagged items are optional polish, so this can ship as drafted.
